claim: The Q1 2026 filing puts PepsiCo's revenue at $19.4 million.
summary: While the exact Q1 2026 filing postdates the knowledge cutoff and cannot be verified, the claimed $19.4 million scale is contradicted by known PepsiCo scale of tens of billions per quarter.

sub_claims.text: PepsiCo has a Q1 2026 filing that reports revenue
sub_claims.note: Q1 2026 ends after knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04, so the existence and content of that specific filing is not established by prior knowledge alone.

From prior knowledge PepsiCo quarterly revenue is on the order of tens of billions of dollars, not millions; $19.4 million is ~1000x too small and inconsistent with known scale, though the exact Q1 2026 figure postdates the cutoff.
